newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Saambou leaps 8 pct after robust results.
newsitem.headline: Saambou leaps 8 pct after robust results.

text.p: Shares in Saambou Ltd, a South African banking and insurance firm, leapt over eight percent in moderate volume after it posted robust growth in year earnings earlier.

Just before noon stocks were trading at a morning best of 865 cents, a gain of 65 cents or 8.1 percent, bucking the overall weaker trend on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's financial 100 index. Some 26,200 shares had changed hands.
"They're up on the results which were in excess of the 22 percent that the market was expecting," a share dealer said.
However, dealers said Saambou stocks had been tending higher to the 850 cent level all of last week, although coming off towards the close. Saambou touched a year high of 880 cents on May 9.
Saambou earlier reported share earnings of 40 cents each, an improvement of over 32 percent from 30.2 last year. The dividend was raised to eight cents from six cents before.
